name: CAPA Private Cluster Provisioning
description: Provision a ROSA HCP PrivateLink cluster using CAPA with endpointAccess: Private (no public API/ingress endpoint) on MCE 5.0 RC (OpenShift 5.0.0-ec.6, candidate channel), with automated network and role configuration

playbooks.name: Create CAPA Private Cluster
playbooks.description: Provisions a ROSA HCP PrivateLink cluster using CAPA with endpointAccess set to Private, plus ROSANetwork and ROSARoleConfig automation

documentation.overview: This test suite provisions a ROSA HCP PrivateLink cluster using CAPA. The RosaControlPlane is rendered from the rosa-private-cluster feature template, which sets endpointAccess: Private so the cluster API and ingress are reachable only over AWS PrivateLink (no public endpoint). Validated against MCE 5.0 RC on OpenShift 5.0.0-ec.6 (candidate channel).
prerequisites: MCE/ACM hub cluster (5.0 RC) with CAPI/CAPA configured
Network reachability to the private cluster endpoint (VPN, bastion, or peered VPC) for post-provision access
expected_results: ROSANetwork and ROSARoleConfig resources created (network + IAM automation)
RosaControlPlane applied from the rosa-private-cluster template with endpointAccess: Private
Cluster provisions with no public API/ingress endpoint (Private)
Cluster API and ingress are reachable only over AWS PrivateLink
Playbook waits for RosaControlPlane status.ready to become true
